First, convert 20 weeks and 1 day to days:  
20 weeks × 7 days/week = 140 days, plus 1 day = 141 days before.  

Date given: 1242-03-28 (assuming format is MM-DD-YYYY).  
Subtract 141 days:  

March has 31 days, so going back:  
From March 28:  
- 28 days back → March 0 → Feb 28 (1242 is not a leap year, because 1242 not divisible by 4).  
Continue: 141 total days back.  

Better:  
141 days before March 28, 1242:  
Step 1: Back into February: March 28 → March 1 is 27 days back.  
141 - 27 = 114 days left to go back.  
February 1242 has 28 days → 114 - 28 = 86 days left.  
January 1242 has 31 days → 86 - 31 = 55 days left.  
December 1241 has 31 days → 55 - 31 = 24 days left.  
November 1241 has 30 days → 24 - 30 = -6 days (means we stop in November).  

So: November 30, 1241 minus 6 days = November 24, 1241.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1241-11-24
